items.title: Milika Tembo Academic & Social Research Portfolio
items.description: Designed and developed a sleek, modern web portfolio for researcher Milika Tembo to showcase her publication history, ongoing research initiatives, and academic contributions. The platform features an intuitive layout that organizes complex publications into easily navigable categories, highlights research impacts, and provides a seamless contact channel for academic collaboration and speaking engagements.

items.title: MUCHINGA YOUTH SUMMIT REGISTRATION WEBSITE
items.description: We designed and deployed a comprehensive event registration website for the Ubuntu Youth Network, featuring an integrated admin panel that streamlines participant management. The custom-built system enables the organization to seamlessly register attendees, review and approve submissions, and automatically trigger confirmation emails upon approval, ensuring a smooth and automated workflow for summit and masterclass programs.

items.title: WEBSITE DEVELOPMENT & CONTACT PAGE CONFIGUARATION
items.description: Growthive Media developed and officially handed over the corporate web platform for Vonga Capital, a prominent Zambian holding company specializing in patient capital allocation and long-term operating investments across technology, commodities, logistics, finance, and real estate. The custom-built digital platform reflects Vonga's institutional heritage and independent philosophy, featuring comprehensive portfolio showcases, executive leadership profiles, and a secure interactive partnership submission portal to seamlessly connect founders, operators, and capital partners with the firm's executive team.
